report.title: WIP: A way to reflect on notes
report.body:
### Check before submitting

- [x] I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate

### What problem would this solve?

I have been loving memos lately, i use it for brainstorming, writing notes everything, however there is just one problem:

Its hard to reflect on the notes i created. like i got a cool new thought, i capture it in memos, but after that? it gets buried in the gallery of notes.

### What would you like to happen?

There must be a form of feature that lets a user reflect on the notes they created recently, or a lot of time ago.
Because often these "cool thoughts" i get, don't get thought about ever again and it misses the entire point of me writing down a thought at all.

### Additional context

One way i could think of maybe: Have a button in the toolbar when writing the note that lets us set a reminder. and have a page for reviewing these reminded notes, so i can come back to those notes later on.
